## Relevant Symbols
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:420` — the only writer of `--kind verdict` from a verify run: the one line the loop replaces.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:418-419` — the verified head is recorded before the block/advance; a FAIL records `none`. Kept first.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:746` — `ledger.sh run` (headless) releases the owner before `transcribe` (`:755`); `--finish` does the same at `:459`. So `rework` sees an unowned entry on both paths.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:65` — the launcher unsets `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` for its own ledger calls, so `HEFESTO_LAUNCHER=1` + no session id (`ledger.sh:296`) holds inside a lane's `--finish` too.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:370` — on a merge-forward `pr`, `record --forward-consumed --person-text-consumed`; the rework arm mirrors it.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:500` — `forward_schema` widens the implement schema only on a forward run: the fixture-preserving pattern.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:513-514` — `plan_review_rounds` read with a jq that refuses `false` (`// 5` would treat it as absent).
- `hooks/ledger.sh:518-528` — implement claims count attempts; the move resets them (as `forward_write:299`), so each round gets the stall cap afresh.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:589-592` — a non-PASS verdict clears the verified head (`am_vh_clear_jq`): auto-merge cannot ride a reworked head.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:731-737` — `record --person-text-consumed` and `--forward-consumed`: the model for `--rework-consumed`.
- `hooks/ledger-lifecycle.sh:22-23` (`session-launch-forward.sh`) — rows older than the last `reopen` event are closed.
- `hooks/ledger-lifecycle.sh:298-300` — `forward_write` consumes every earlier answer, so an old answer never steers the new work.
- `hooks/ledger-lanes.sh:113` — `questions_item`'s kind gate: one extra arm for `verdict` with a `question_path`.
- `hooks/hefesto-setup.sh:148-150` — every `ledger.sh` subcommand must be classified (allow / sign / launcher); `tests/smoke-signatures.sh` diffs the lists against the dispatch both ways, so `rework` must land in `LEDGER_LAUNCHER` and `rework --past-cap` in `LEDGER_SIGN_FLAG`.
- `hooks/lane-guard.sh:166`, `hooks/ledger.sh:283,295` — `is_launcher_sub "$SUB"` is called with the subcommand only; a launcher-only verb with a person form needs its arguments.

## Existing Patterns & Conventions
- Backward moves refuse before the first write and print one line (`ledger-lifecycle.sh:168-170`, constitution 5); a cap is not a refusal but one written block with a question file, exit 0, so the routing caller never loops (`forward_block_reason:272`).
- Generated briefs: fixed template, `rm -f` then write (never through a link), sha256 in the row, re-hashed by `person_text_as_data` at launch (`session-launch.sh:314-335`), delimited with a nonce.
- Sourced arms keep `session-launch.sh` under its 500-code-line limit (`session-launch-forward.sh:3-5`).
- Every guard gets an in-test `sed` mutation in its smoke file (constitution 3; `tests/smoke-forward.sh`).
- Config ints are validated where read, with a message naming the value and the expected shape (`session-launch.sh:514`, `ledger.sh:495`).
